pain_point: Tax and depreciation benefits unclear - I heard you get better tax deductions buying new but my accountant hasn't explained it properly
primary_text: "My accountant hasn't explained it properly." Let us help. When you buy a brand-new warehouse, you can claim depreciation on the building structure at 2.5% per year for 40 years, plus accelerated depreciation on plant and equipment items like roller doors, air conditioning, and electrical systems. On a new Truganina warehouse, that can mean tens of thousands in tax deductions annually. Compare that to buying a 20-year-old shed where most of the depreciation benefit is gone. Off-the-plan means everything is new. Every dollar of construction cost becomes a potential deduction. Request our depreciation guide and take it to your next accountant meeting.
description: Claim building depreciation at 2.5% per year plus accelerated plant write-offs
